name: geo-orchestrator
title: GEO Review Orchestrator: Local Evidence Baseline
description: Coordinate local website, listing, content-opportunity and imported-answer checks when the relevant inputs are supplied.
prerequisites: Node 24+, local shell/filesystem, separately installed pinned CLI; no sibling skill.
limits: A baseline of local evidence, not live indexing, analytics, store approval or growth measurement.
useCases: Build a baseline from supplied web/app artifacts and imported records.
Identify traceable fixes and remaining measurement gaps.

name: web-geo
title: Web GEO Audit: Inspect Your HTML Export
description: Inspect exported HTML metadata, canonical/sitemap coverage and duplicates, crawler files and JSON-LD syntax.
prerequisites: Node 24+, local shell/filesystem, separately installed pinned CLI; no sibling skill.
limits: No deployed crawl, JavaScript/CSS rendering, HTTP/WAF inspection, schema semantics or indexing/ranking measurement.
useCases: Review a public export before an authorized deployment.
Inspect sitemap duplicates, metadata and separate search/training policies.

name: app-geo-aso
title: App Listing Review: iOS and Android Metadata
description: Check supplied iOS/Android listing field limits and fact references; retain missing-data and semantic/localization gaps.
prerequisites: Node 24+, local shell/filesystem, separately installed pinned CLI; no sibling skill.
limits: No store-console access, screenshot/device testing, semantic truth, localization quality or publishing approval.
useCases: Review proposed listing text before console entry.
Identify missing locale/fact evidence for human review.

name: geo-content-engine
title: GEO Content Planner: Questions and Product Facts
description: Turn supplied audience questions and product fact IDs into traceable opportunities and research gaps.
prerequisites: Node 24+, local shell/filesystem, separately installed pinned CLI; no sibling skill.
limits: Source URLs are traceability pointers, not fetched verification; no demand, traffic or publishable-page promise.
useCases: Prioritize a supplied question list using product-fact IDs.
Keep unsupported topics in a research-gap list.

name: geo-visibility-tracker
title: AI Answer Visibility Tracker: Imported Evidence
description: Compute mentions, owned-host citations, competitor counts and collection coverage from recorded answers.
prerequisites: Node 24+, local shell/filesystem, separately installed pinned CLI; no sibling skill.
limits: No paid sampling, consumer-interface scraping or answer authentication; mentions do not establish recommendations.
useCases: Review mentions and citations in recorded answer sets.
Compare successful-response rates alongside failed collection coverage.
